text: dsh-flowglass-en 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话流程可视化插件。它通过侧边栏入口和面板展示用户消息、助手工作、工具调用及结果，并支持子代理导航和并发会话的 Flow Zoom 视图。用户可以查看执行分支、切换紧凑/详情/思维导图布局，并在分支间导航。适合需要追踪 DSH 会话执行过程和并行任务的用户。源码未显示需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-flowglass-en visualizes DSH web sessions as flows of messages, tool calls, and results. Its sidebar panel supports subagent navigation and Flow Zoom views of concurrent branches, with compact, detail, and mind map layouts.
dsh-flowglass-en 的功能「会话流程与并发分支视图」：在 DSH 网页侧栏打开面板后，可查看会话消息、工具调用和结果形成的执行流程，并用 Flow Zoom 浏览并发分支、切换不同视图或进入分支会话。

dsh-flowglass-en README · Flowglass English (`dsh-flowglass-en`)：An English-only live session flow visualizer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness). Flowglass turns users, assistant responses, tool calls, parallel work, and subagents into an interactive execution graph.

This package has its own npm and runtime identities, so it can be installed without colliding with the original Chinese package.

dsh-flowglass-en README · Features：- Live three-lane visualization for user messages, assistant work, tool calls, and results.
- Clickable details for messages, tools, models, token usage, and subagents.
- Nested subagent navigation and session-aware branch continuation.
- Flow Zoom views for concurrent sessions, including compact, detailed, and map layouts.
- Persistent topology history for evolving `1-to-N` branches.
- Configurable refresh interval, default branch count, default view, and tool presentation rules.
- Native right-sidebar integration, Better Sidebar compatibility, and a built-in fallback panel.
- English-only interface, settings, errors, logs, and package metadata. No translation engine is included.

dsh-flowglass-en README · Requirements：- Node.js 22.19 or newer
- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 or newer

dsh-flowglass-en README · Install：From npm after publication:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-flowglass-en@0.6.1
```

From a local package tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-flowglass-en-0.6.1.tgz
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness after installation. To remove it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-flowglass-en
```

dsh-flowglass-en README · Build from source：```sh
npm run build
npm run check:english
npm pack
```

The generated native package is synchronized to `flowglass/`. The English-only check scans the source files and generated package for Han characters.

dsh-flowglass-en README · Runtime architecture：- `flowglass/lib/index.js`: native Host plugin.
- `flowglass/lib/client.js`: native web Client plugin.
- `flowglass/lib/remote.js`: Host/Client Remote contract.
- Bundle ID: `flowglass-en`.
- Package and configuration identity: `dsh-flowglass-en`.
- No `dynamicCordisRunner` or generated `dyn/*` packages are used.

dsh-flowglass-en README · Development：The source of truth is:

- `plugins/flow/tool.js`
- `plugins/toolbox/client.js`
- `plugins/toolbox/host.js`
- `shared/`
- `build/`

Run the complete local verification with:

```sh
npm test
```

dsh-flowglass-en README · Credits：This English-only standalone package is based on the original Chinese [Iwctwbh/dsh-flowglass](https://github.com/Iwctwbh/dsh-flowglass) project. Thanks to its author and contributors for the original Flowglass design and implementation.

This repository is independently maintained and is not an official English release of the upstream project.
